import json,sys,numpy as np,xarray as xr
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)

# 1. reader path on a REAL file (netcdf4 engine): known structure + deterministic stat.
#    Air temp NCEP reanalysis, pydata/xarray-data air_temperature.nc @ 2baf0c22d967.
ds=xr.open_dataset("/tmp/air.nc")
var="air" if "air" in ds else list(ds.data_vars)[0]
shp=tuple(ds[var].shape); mean=round(float(ds[var].mean()),6)
check("netcdf_var", var=="air", f"{var}  want air")
check("netcdf_shape", shp==(2920,25,53), f"{shp}  want (2920, 25, 53)")
check("netcdf_mean", abs(mean-281.255037)<1e-4, f"{mean}  want 281.255037 K (deterministic reader stat)")

# 2. xESMF conservative regrid CONSERVATION: on global periodic grids a conservative
#    scheme reproduces a constant field exactly -- the conservation law, exact-or-wrong.
import xesmf as xe
src=xe.util.grid_global(5,4); dst=xe.util.grid_global(8,6)
ny,nx=src["lat"].shape
rg=xe.Regridder(src,dst,"conservative",periodic=True)
out=rg(xr.DataArray(np.ones((ny,nx)),dims=("y","x")))
cmin,cmax=round(float(out.min()),8),round(float(out.max()),8)
check("regrid_conservation", abs(cmin-1.0)<1e-6 and abs(cmax-1.0)<1e-6,
      f"[{cmin},{cmax}]  want [1.0,1.0] (constant preserved -> conservative)")

# 3. metpy companion identity: wind speed of (3,4) m/s = 5 exactly
from metpy.calc import wind_speed
from metpy.units import units
spd=round(float(wind_speed(np.array([3.0])*units("m/s"), np.array([4.0])*units("m/s")).magnitude[0]),6)
check("metpy_windspeed", abs(spd-5.0)<1e-6, f"{spd}  want 5.0 (3-4-5)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
